  - Bounded hyperbolas: Draw hyperbola arcs from two foci and start/end points, with snapping, tangent construction, transformations, and trimming. Bounded arcs can be saved and read through rational DXF spline conversion. #2827

Includes Lao language support, updated Japanese and Traditional Chinese translations, and other translation corrections. #2991, #2729, #2735, #3143

  - Undo/Redo and entity ownership: Fix crashes and unintended changes when property dialogs or modify tools encounter generated text/dimension geometry or block children, and make re-filleting corners safe for Undo/Redo. #2878
